focus_areas: Integrity of the chain-link fence pattern
Clarity and definition of the feet/toes through the grass
Transition between neck hackles and body feathers
Presence and shape of the tarsal spur
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interaction between the bird's feet and the ground; AI often struggles with feet grounding in grass. Also, scrutinize the chain-link fence for any broken loops or impossible geometries, as this is a common failure point. Verify if the tail feathers have the correct curvature or if they appear stiff/unnatural. Use the bounding box from the detector to strictly limit the pose auditor's search for the spur and toes.
image_description: A rooster (cock) standing in a grassy area with a chain-link fence and reddish foliage in the background. The bird has brown body plumage, iridescent green/black neck feathers, and prominent red comb and wattles. It is facing away from the camera but turning its head slightly to the left.
